title: Simplify Site Governance with Self-Service Ownership Transfer in Power Pages
summary: Learn how self-service site ownership transfer in Power Pages simplifies ownership changes, strengthens governance, and supports business continuity.
body_markdown:
Every Power Pages site starts with an owner. Over time, however, organizations evolve – employees change roles, teams reorganize, projects move between departments, and responsibilities shift. While the people behind a site may change, the site itself often continues serving customers, partners, employees, citizens or other users for years.


Keeping site ownership aligned with current business responsibilities is an important part of maintaining operational continuity and governance. That’s why we’re introducing **self-service site ownership transfer in Power Pages** .


#### **Helping Site Ownership Move with Your Business**


Ownership changes are a natural part of an organization’s lifecycle. Common scenarios include:


- an employee moves to a new role or leaves the organisation.


- a project transitions from an implementation team to an operations team.


- responsibility for a business process shifts to another department.


- a different team takes over management of an existing site.


Previously, updating site ownership would require additional administrative effort. With self-service site ownership transfer, eligible site owners and service administrators can transfer ownership of a Power Pages site to another eligible user within the same tenant, making ownership transitions simpler and more efficient.


#### **Supporting Governance and Accountability**


To support governance and transparency, ownership transfer activities capture information about the transfer, including the previous owner, the new owner, who initiated the transfer, and when the transfer occurred. Relevant stakeholders (old owners, new owners, and relevant system administrators) are notified by email.


This helps organisations maintain visibility into ownership changes while keeping governance processes aligned with evolving business needs.


#### **Keeping Sites Manageable Over Time**


Power Pages sites are often long-lived business assets. As teams and responsibilities change, organisations need a simple way to keep ownership records current without creating unnecessary operational overhead.


**Self-service site ownership transfer** helps organizations efficiently manage routine ownership handovers, maintain accountability, and ensure sites continue to be managed by the individuals responsible for them.


#### Get started


Learn more: ****[Transfer ownership of a Power Pages site](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-pages/admin/transfer-ownership)****

Your feedback is crucial in shaping the future of this feature. We want to[hear from you!](https://ideas.powerpages.microsoft.com/d365community/forum/1edba0ec-30cf-ec11-a7b5-000d3a545c96)
